items.title: Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses
items.title_zh: 对话式 LLM 智能体的网络搜索特征：从搜索决策、策略到结果与响应
items.summary: The study examines web search across ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and DeepSeek using real user interactions and controlled API experiments, covering when agents search, how they formulate queries, which domains results come from and how responses are grounded. It finds search decisions vary by platform and model, more frequent search does not necessarily improve quality, and some claims rely on uncited results.

items.title: Efficiently Linking Unstructured Data for Multi-step Reasoning
items.title_zh: 为非结构化数据高效建立关联以支持多步推理
items.summary: DASE is a query engine that ranks candidate evidence tuples for multi-step reasoning over structured predicates, multiple vectors and relational links, using a sparse materialized embedding-similarity join index for rare near-neighbor pairs. On scientific-discovery workloads it retrieves evidence 6x to 46x faster than RDBMS, rerank and vector-database baselines at comparable recall, and on SemBench E-Commerce it raises BigQuery answer quality from 0.67 to 0.80 while cutting cost from $2.42 to $0.54.

items.title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
items.title_zh: ScienceIDE：将全球科学代码库转化为智能体可学习环境
items.summary: ScienceIDE converts scientific code repositories into executable environments for agent task generation, execution and verification, guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria. Using verified interaction trajectories, the authors train PhAI-IDE models at 72B, 9B and 4B parameters that improve held-out scientific-code repair and show gains on selected general code, reasoning and knowledge benchmarks.

items.title: BI-Agent and BI-Bench: Towards Automating End-to-End Business Intelligence
items.title_zh: BI-Agent 与 BI-Bench：迈向端到端商业智能自动化
items.summary: BI-Bench harvests real business-intelligence questions and ground-truth answers from public dashboards, and finds frontier LLMs score below 50% on end-to-end BI. The tool-augmented BI-Agent decomposes search, join and transform subtasks and gains up to 40 percentage points over vanilla LLMs, while post-training on synthesized trajectories adds up to 30 points.

items.title: Cognitive Extensions for Dual-Process Language Agents: Memory and Self-Reflection in Interactive Environments
items.title_zh: 双过程语言智能体的认知扩展：交互环境中的记忆与自我反思
items.summary: The authors add an Adaptive Memory Module for salience-gated episodic storage and trigger-driven retrieval, plus a Self-Reflection Module for bounded execution-time validation, to the SwiftSage dual-process agent. On ScienceWorld the full system reaches a mean final score of 64.62 and a 43.17% success rate, with self-reflection the strongest standalone contributor.

items.title: A Benchmark Framework for Screening Automation in Systematic Reviews
items.title_zh: 系统综述筛选自动化的基准框架
items.summary: The paper releases a benchmark of 45,064 labeled entries drawn from 32 systematic reviews for evaluating LLM article screening under class imbalance, together with PromptSR for prompt experimentation, experiment management and result analysis. A use case demonstrates the benchmark and tool.

items.title: SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features
items.title_zh: SCOUT：基于冻结视频特征嵌入空间预测的仿真到真实文本行人检索
items.summary: SCOUT keeps its video and text encoders frozen and trains a predictor that maps V-JEPA patch tokens into an EmbeddingGemma embedding space under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective. With ExPLoRA adaptation and a reranker, the full system reaches 84.25 mAP@10 on AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4.

items.title: Hex turns complex analysis into visual reports with GPT‑6 Astra
items.title_zh: Hex 借助 GPT-6 Astra 将复杂分析转化为可视化报告
items.summary: OpenAI says GPT-6 Astra helps Hex's data agents turn answers into interactive visualizations that employees can share.
